product_overview: Gestion Scolaire is an offline-first Electron desktop application (Arabic RTL) that centralizes Moroccan high-school administrative workflows — student records, grades, absences, timetables, documents, and licensing — using a local SQLite database.
core_goals: Provide an Arabic, offline-capable administrative tool tailored to Moroccan lycées qualifiants that replaces fragmented Excel/paper workflows.
Enable robust import/export and reporting workflows (Massar Excel, FET timetables, printable documents) while keeping data local and secure.
Offer a license and telemetry system for device management and paid distribution while preserving an offline activation path.
Stabilize and consolidate IPC surfaces, enforce auth for destructive bulk operations, and complete key feature gaps (timetable DB, student profile).

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate users with local credentials to unlock application features and scoped permissions.
user_flows: Navigate to /login.html -> Fill username input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See dashboard at /index.html
Navigate to /login.html -> Fill username input field -> Leave password field blank -> Click Login button to submit -> See error message about invalid credentials -> Stay on /login.html

features.name: Student Bulk Import (Massar Excel)
features.description: Import student lists from Excel (Massar-compatible) with automatic header detection and deduplication by student code.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Open Data Import section -> Drag Excel file to import drop zone -> App parses Excel and detects headers -> App shows import preview with deduplication results -> Confirm import -> See success message and new students present in registry
Navigate to /index.html -> Open Data Import section -> Drag non-Excel or malformed file to import drop zone -> App attempts parse -> See file format/parsing error message -> No data is imported

features.name: Student Search & Profile
features.description: Search, filter, and open per-student profiles (grades, absences, documents) scoped by school year.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Open Students page -> Fill search field with student name or code -> Click Search button or press Enter -> See paginated list of matching students (25/page) -> Click a student row -> See student profile modal with grades and KPIs
Navigate to /index.html -> Open Students page -> Fill search field with a non-matching term -> Click Search button or press Enter -> See 'No results' message -> Remain on Students page

features.name: Timetable (FET XML Import & Views)
features.description: Import FET XML timetables and view pre-generated static timetable HTML by teacher, class, or room. Current implementation stores FET output in timetables/ and localStorage; DB-backed queries are stubbed.
user_flows: Navigate to /timetable.html -> Click Import FET XML (file picker) -> Select a valid FET XML file -> App saves generated static timetable HTML to timetables/ and stores metadata in localStorage -> See timetable rendered in the selected view (by teacher/class/room) on /timetable.html
Navigate to /timetable.html -> Click Import FET XML (file picker) -> Select an invalid or incompatible XML file -> App fails parsing -> See parsing error message -> Timetable view remains unchanged

features.name: Backup & Restore
features.description: Create full backups (localStorage + Base64 SQLite snapshot) as a single JSON file and restore with integrity validation.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Open Settings/Backup section -> Click Create Backup -> App generates JSON backup containing localStorage and Base64 SQLite snapshot -> Save file via OS save dialog -> See success confirmation

Navigate to /index.html -> Open Settings/Backup section -> Click Restore -> Select a JSON backup file with invalid or corrupted SQLite snapshot -> App validates SQLite integrity -> See validation error and restore aborted -> Original data remains unchanged

features.name: License Activation & Limited Mode
features.description: Activate offline HMAC-SHA256-signed serials to unlock licensed features; manage trial and limited-mode behavior when no valid license is present.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Open License/Activation dialog -> Paste serial key into input -> Click Activate -> App verifies serial offline -> See activation success and full feature access unlocked

Navigate to /index.html -> Open License/Activation dialog -> Paste malformed or unknown serial key -> Click Activate -> App rejects serial and shows error message -> App remains in limited mode with restricted pages
